cohort: Primiparous mothers aged 18-44 who gave birth between July 1, 2000 and December 31, 2005 in New South Wales, Australia
finding: Mental and behavioural disorders, especially unipolar depressions, adjustment disorders, acute psychotic episodes, and schizophrenia or schizophrenia-like disorders during the first year after birth, led to long hospital stays and a large number of admissions.
